questions.question: In vibe coding, who writes the code?

options.text: The AI writes, you steer and check
options.explanation: Exactly. You say what you want and evaluate the result.
That would be traditional programming. In vibe coding, the AI writes the code.

options.text: The code appears by itself without instructions
options.explanation: The AI always needs your instructions. The clearer you are, the better the result.

questions.question: The AI answers in a confident voice. What do you do?

options.text: I trust the answer, because it sounds confident
options.explanation: A confident tone doesn’t guarantee a correct answer. The AI can be wrong.

options.text: I try it out and check the result myself
options.explanation: Good! Open the site, try out the features and ask more if needed.

options.text: I don’t use AI at all
options.explanation: AI is a useful tool. It’s enough that you check the work it produces.

questions.question: What is a vibe coder’s most important skill?

options.text: Knowing a programming language by heart
options.explanation: You don’t need that. The AI takes care of writing the code.

options.text: Explaining clearly: what, why and within which limits
options.explanation: Correct! Good instructions are half the work.
Speed doesn’t hurt, but clear thinking is far more important.
